verdict.rationale: Transactional sending is a fair question for an email marketing platform like EmailOctopus. However, the evidence pack documents no transactional email stream with its own templates, suppression rules, or sending reputation. Nothing shows a receipt being delivered to an unsubscribed contact. The cited material covers only marketing features (campaigns, lists, automations, templates) and general API mechanics.

support.subject: As an ops user, transactional email is kept separate from marketing — its own templates, suppression rules, and reputation — so a receipt still delivers to an unsubscribed contact
